certification.name: Google Cloud Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
certification.description: Five-course entry-level program on cloud security with Google Cloud: risk management, identity and access, threat detection, and incident response using tools such as Security Command Center. Course-based certificate assessed through hands-on labs, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 2 months at 10 hours a week.
